title: Embedded Technician Efficiency chart follows real report data and date window
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin with the Reports permission (storage state)
One invoiced Work Order in the current month at the active workplace, with a billable technician's clocked time on its labour line (seeded via API)
Browser storage holds no `report_visualization_open_techEfficiencySeries` key, so the chart opens on its default (open)

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Reports > Technician Efficiency with the date filter on This Month
custom_steps_separated.expected: The report loads and the chart toggle reports the chart as open

custom_steps_separated.content: Wait for the chart above the tabs to finish loading
custom_steps_separated.expected: A rendered chart is shown, not the loading skeleton, an error, or "No data for selected date range"

custom_steps_separated.content: Change the report's date filter to a custom range in January 2001
custom_steps_separated.expected:
The chart reloads for the new window and shows "No data for selected date range"

The embedded chart on the Technician Efficiency report draws real data for the report's own date window and follows the window when it changes
